Tender is of two cover system.

EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Conditional tenders will not be accepted.
Aspiring Bidders/Contractors who have not obtained the user ID & Password for participating in e-Procurement, may now obtain the same from the website www.eproc.karnataka.gov.in.

Corrigendum or modification or corrections, if any, will be published in the website only. Section I,II,III, Instruction to bidders and Form of Bid are part of the Tender document.

The bidder must visit to the Linganamakki power house to evaluate the Nature and quantum of work involved, Condition of the working place, Tools, safety Equipments, required Scaffoldings/Ladders and it is mandatory to upload the site inspection certificate attached in document section of this bid which is signed by both tender inviting authority and bidder as a PQR document while submitting the bid and considered it as a proof of visit to power house.
